title: Welcome to the Windmill Experience
preview: Begin the walk in a restored village created to preserve the memory of old Kefalos: the windmill, the family home, the bakery, the herbs, the tunnel and the work of everyday island life.
details: Mylotopi brings together restored spaces that once shaped daily life in Kefalos. Stone walls, wooden mechanisms, family objects and handmade tools are presented as a living story rather than a static display.

The Voudouris family restored this place with respect for local memory, so younger visitors can understand how people worked, cooked, slept, stored food and shared village life before modern comforts.

items.label: The windmill
items.text: A working landmark connected with wheat, flour, weather, craft and the rhythm of the village.

items.label: Village life
items.text: A traditional house, bakery, garden and threshing floor that show how families lived with care and practicality.

items.label: Hidden history
items.text: The Italian tunnel and cellar add a quieter story from the 1940s beneath the warm village surface.

details.text: How to use the audio guide

details: Select your language, choose the stop you are visiting, then play the audio when you are ready. The guide is designed for a slow outdoor walk, so you can pause, look around and continue at your own pace.

challenge.label: For young visitors
challenge.title: Carry the details with you
challenge.intro: As you walk, notice colors, shapes and textures that you may want to remember later.

items.text: Look for stone, wood, sails, old tools and family objects that make Mylotopi feel alive.
Choose one detail from each stop that best tells the story of old Kefalos.
